messages.subject: problems unzipping script files
messages.body_plain:
Dear R experts,

I am just starting to read the sflwr book but I have a problem with
downloading the script files. I am not at all a computer expert, so I
need some help...

I managed to download the zipped files, and I unzipped the input and
output files succesfully. But the script files could not be unzipped
because the system does not recognize the compression method. - So I
get a new map, but it is empty.

What can I do to solve this?

Thank you very much for your help!

Clara
